description: Tests over 1 s in the unit, contract and integration tiers, each with the reason it is slow. An entry leaves when its test is fast; none is added without a reason and an owner step in the open items of the target architecture.

tests.test: packages/agent-remote-lab/src/App.render-budget.test.tsx > switching bots renders the conversations that change and leaves the others alone
tests.reason: Mounts the whole Workbench with 12 groups of 10 bots over the bot-mode fixture and counts renders through a change: stage 6's render budget is a property of the composed page, which no unit owns (kept as composition, docs/current/agent-remote/workbench-state.md). The mount and the renders of 120 views take about 0.85 s, and real settle waits add 0.55 s (100 ms after each of four bot switches, 50 ms after each of three counted changes). The waits cannot simply run on the fake clock: the page's own timers then fire at other points, and in this file's sequence a switch renders the hidden Window panes. It leaves when the budget is shown on a smaller page or the page's timers are inputs.
